details.description: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B is a 14.7-billion-parameter model in Alibaba Cloud's Qwen2.5-Coder family of code-focused language models, released November 12, 2024. This is the base pretrained checkpoint, not the instruction-tuned variant: it was trained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, text-code grounding, and synthetic data, but the model card explicitly states the maker does not recommend using base language models directly for conversations. Alibaba's Qwen GitHub organization has since retitled its coder repository for the newer Qwen3-Coder family, though the Qwen2.5-Coder-14B weights remain published on Hugging Face with no explicit deprecation notice on the model card itself.
advantages: Trained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, text-code grounding, and synthetic data, per the model card.
Part of a family the maker says supports more than 40 programming languages, per the Qwen2.5-Coder blog.
The model card lists a full context length of 131,072 tokens (via YaRN scaling), versus a 32,768-token default configuration.
disadvantages: This is the base pretrained checkpoint, not instruction-tuned; the model card states the maker does not recommend using base language models directly for conversations without further fine-tuning (SFT/RLHF/continued pretraining).
Text-only model with no image, audio, or video input support.
The model card gives no benchmark numbers specific to this 14B size in text form, only chart comparisons across the Qwen2.5-Coder family.
use_cases: Base checkpoint for further fine-tuning (SFT/RLHF) into a coding assistant
Code completion and code generation research
Code agent application development requiring further post-training

sources.title: QwenLM/Qwen2.5-Coder (GitHub org repo, now retitled Qwen3-Coder)

notes: The Bud catalog lists this as kind 'chat' served at /v1/chat/completions, but the maker's own model card says it does not recommend using this base (non-instruct) checkpoint for conversations -- flagged as a disadvantage above. The model card's headline context length (131,072 tokens via YaRN, default config 32,768) differs from the catalog's max_input/max_output of 32768; the catalog's value is kept per instructions. No exact benchmark numbers for the 14B base size were found in text form; the family blog post presents comparisons only as chart images, which this agent could not read, so evaluations is left empty. github.com/QwenLM/Qwen2.5-Coder now displays Qwen3-Coder content, used only as evidence Alibaba's primary coder repo has moved to Qwen3-Coder; github_url is left null since there is no dedicated current repo for this exact model. No language list is published for this model (code-focused, English documentation), so languages is left empty.
